international.title: Home Office accused of trying to cancel online talk by Andreas Malm
international.summary: Hackney mayor decries ‘assault’ on free speech over event featuring academic who is banned from entering UK Shabana Mahmood has been accused of an “assault” on free speech over claims her officials tried to cancel an online talk by the climate academic Andreas Malm days after he was banned from entering the UK. The event in Hackney, east London, was a launch party for the socialist magazine Tribune. It went ahead on 4 November in defiance of Home Office warnings. Continue reading...
